newsitem.title: USA: MedCare to open seven sites by yearend.
newsitem.headline: MedCare to open seven sites by yearend.

text.p: MedCare Technologies Inc. said Thursday it plans to add seven sites to its existing five centers which offer a behavior modification program to treat urinary incontinence.
MedCare said it will open a center next month in Raleigh, N.C., in conjunction with Dr. Richard Kane and Triangle Urological Associates Inc..
The company plans other sites in Stamford, Conn.; Milwaukee, Wis.; Miami, Fla.; and Chicago, Ill.

"The company has ample cash reserves, no debt, excellent managerial and clinical staff, and the patient traffic at our recently opened Program sites are in line with expectations," said Harmel Rayat, MedCare chairman and chief executive.
"We are now ready to start adding new MedCare Program sites around the U.S.," he said in a news release.
MedCare also said it is seeking to list its common shares for trading on the Nasdaq Small Cap market.
Shares of MedCare were trading unchanged at 6-13/16.
